heading: Training & Coaching
intro: We deliver practical and meaningful training, that is derived from clinical mental health and wellbeing practices. Our mission is to empower leaders of people to support their teams proactively and effectively.
body:
Wellbeing in the workplace is about so much more than just awareness, and we aim to empower organisations to develop and improve the wellbeing services they offer. So our training and coaching courses have been designed to equip organisations and leaders with meaningful skills they can use to support their teams. From spotting the signs of mental health struggles to effective signposting, these courses cover the aspects of workplace wellbeing that matter to the workforce.

Sessions include case studies, personal reflection and collaboration, to help develop a realistic understanding of how and why people struggle at work, how leaders can be vital in supporting staff and what makes a workforce feel valued. But sessions are also adaptable, to ensure the training we deliver is suitable and relevant for your organisation and it's needs.

cards.title: Wellbeing Services Training
cards.description: Foundational training for whole organisations and teams: what do effective and relevant workplace wellbeing services look like, how to understand the needs of your workforce, and how to encourage staff to access support.

cards.title: Training for Managers & HR
cards.description: Focused work with the people who hold formal responsibility — supportive conversations, reasonable adjustments, absence and return-to-work, and referral routes.

cards.title: Reflective Practice & Coaching
cards.description: Regular facilitated space for teams in emotionally demanding roles, or one-to-one coaching for leaders carrying the weight of other people's wellbeing.

checklistItems.text: Knowing where a manager's role ends

quote: "In 2024/25, over 900,000 workers experienced work-related stress, anxiety or depression — costing 22.1 million working days."

faqs.question: Who is this for?
faqs.answer: Any organisation whose people manage other people. I have delivered this work across sectors including media and manufacturing, with groups of varying sizes.

faqs.question: Is it delivered on-site or remotely?
faqs.answer: Either. On-site tends to work better for interactive sessions with smaller groups; remote delivery makes it far easier to reach people spread across multiple locations.

faqs.question: Can training be combined with therapeutic support?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it often is. Several organisations contract me for both — training for managers alongside confidential therapy available to employees. The two remain entirely separate: nothing from a therapy session reaches the organisation.

faqs.question: How is it priced?
faqs.answer: Per session or as a package, depending on scope. Get in touch with a rough idea of audience and format and I will send an outline and a quote.

ctaText: Tell me who you would like me to work with, roughly how long you have, and what has prompted it. I will come back with a proposed outline and a quote — with no obligation.
